rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for chemical metal or an alloy.

example.english: This thing is made of metal.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 hai6 gam1 suk6 zou6 ge3

rows.note: Use this for the heavy-metal music genre rather than the general material term 金屬.

example.english: I listened to heavy metal music all the time when I was young.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣成日聽重金屬音樂。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 sing4 jat6 teng1 cung5 gam1 suk6 jam1 ngok6
